articles.summary: Domino's Pizza Group has delivered a 40.7% share price gain over the past year, which naturally puts a spotlight on whether that move lines up with the cash the business is expected to generate. With the stock now well above levels from the past few years, the key issue is how closely today's valuation tracks its underlying cash flows.
